framingPrompt: Edit this transparent emblem for a shallow keyboard spacebar. Preserve the exact illustration, colours, materials and alpha. Change only composition: scale the entire existing emblem down uniformly to occupy at most the CENTRAL 50% of the image height and at most 65% of its width. Leave a large completely transparent empty margin above and below it. Use a 3:2 landscape canvas. No cropping, no extra objects, no added shadows, no background, no lettering. The object must appear smaller inside the canvas so its full silhouette fits in a very wide short key.
